framework: Y Combinator Guide to Product Development (Michael Seibel)
cycleName: Cycle 1: October Masterclass & 15-Min Ops Diagnostic Launch

goals.label: Goal 1: Acquisition & Core Action
goals.summary: Maximize 15-Min Ops Audit completions (/audit) and October Masterclass registrations (/webinar).
targetMetrics: >=30% conversion from Webinar confirmation screen to starting /audit

goals.label: Goal 2: Activation & Commercial Conversion
goals.summary: Convert Audit & Intake leads (/intake/athlete, /intake/federation) into booked 1-on-1 walkthroughs and closed sprints.
targetMetrics: 2 closed Turnkey Sport Ops Sprints ($2,800–$3,000) per month
100% response within 2 working days on /intake/athlete and /intake/federation

goals.label: Goal 3: Delivery Velocity & Retention (I4I Loop)
goals.summary: Standardize the 21-Day Sprint hand-off, >=10 hrs/wk relief verification, and I4I peer referral loop.
targetMetrics: <=21 days from sprint kickoff to full credential hand-off
>=10 hours/week verified coach administrative time saved
>=1 peer club or diaspora business referral per completed sprint

items.title: Persist Silent Launch, Audit, Webinar & Athlete Intake submissions to Google Sheets + Apps Script
items.needToHave: Forward POST /api/launch-leads, /api/audit, /api/webinar/register, and /api/athlete-leads to the bound Google Sheet + Apps Script Web App with Gmail notifications.
items.niceToHave: Read-only GET /api/cycle-metrics summary endpoint returning aggregate counts by role and friction level.
items.analyticsSpec: Rows logged in Google Sheets tabs (Silent_Launch_Leads, Audit_Diagnostics, Webinar_Registrations, Athlete_Intake).

items.title: 1-Click Webinar & Silent Launch to Audit Pre-fill Handoff (/webinar & / -> /audit)
items.needToHave: Pass name, email, phone, org, and source from /webinar and Silent Launch confirmation CTAs to /audit and pre-populate contact inputs.
items.niceToHave: Auto-focus directly on the Operational Bottlenecks section when contact fields are pre-filled.
items.analyticsSpec: Share of audit_diagnostics with source='webinar-confirmation' or 'silent-launch' divided by total leads (Target >= 30%).

items.title: A/B Experiment: Interactive Workload & Bottlenecks First on /audit
items.needToHave: Reorder /audit form so Step 1 is Operational Load & Bottlenecks (slider + clickable bottleneck cards) and Step 2 is Organization & Contact Info.
items.niceToHave: Live badge counter showing number of bottlenecks selected before submit.
items.analyticsSpec: Audit completion conversion rate (POST /api/audit submissions per /audit visit) before vs. after section swap.

items.title: Channel & UTM Attribution Capture (source / utm_source) on /, /webinar, and /audit
items.needToHave: Add optional source field to LaunchLeadCreate, AuditSubmission, and WebinarRegistration zod contracts; capture ?utm_source= or ?ref= on client pages.
items.analyticsSpec: Conversion breakdown across tg-dm, whatsapp-dm, diaspora-chat, linkedin, silent-launch, and webinar-confirmation.

items.title: Externalize Webinar Zoom URL & Booking Calendar Link into a4a-config.ts
items.needToHave: Move hardcoded Zoom URL in /api/webinar/register and bookingUrl in /api/audit into src/lib/business/a4a-config.ts.
items.niceToHave: Environment variable override support for custom booking links.
items.analyticsSpec: Zero broken join links on live webinar day; tracked bookingUrl click-throughs.

items.title: Inline Field-Level 400 Error Mapping (applyServerErrors) on /audit and /webinar
items.needToHave: Map 400 validation field errors inline on /audit and /webinar forms alongside toast feedback.
items.niceToHave: Auto-scroll to first invalid field on mobile.
items.analyticsSpec: Zero 400 validation drop-offs where mobile users fail to retry.

items.title: Shareable Diagnostic Scorecard Permalink (/audit?id=...)
items.needToHave: Allow club directors to share a read-only link of their Friction Score with board members.
items.analyticsSpec: Secondary share views per generated audit.

items.title: Convert /intake/federation from static mailto to persisted API form
items.needToHave: Create FederationLead model and POST /api/federation-leads handler.
items.analyticsSpec: Persisted institutional intake count (Target for a Goal 2 cycle).

items.title: Bilingual EN/RU Quick-Toggle on /webinar
items.needToHave: Add EN/RU language toggle on /webinar for non-Russian-speaking US fencing club owners.
items.analyticsSpec: Share of webinar registrations from English toggle view.

qaChecklist.check: Vertical hero sequence, Bulachak motto, 3 named branches (A4A, P4P, I4I), co-opetition copy, and top-nav CTAs (/audit, /intake/federation).
All 3 tiers (P//01 $2.8k-$3k, P//02 $1k+8%, P//03 $15k-$18k), 4% P4P badge, 10-Hour Guarantee banner, and FAQ accordion.
Valid club inputs return Friction Score (10-100), Recoverable Hours, Annual Drag Cost, tailored prescriptions, and walkthrough CTA.
Registration confirmation card renders, .ics calendar file downloads cleanly, Concierge FAQ toggles work, and /audit CTA links cleanly.
5-field form maps 400 validation errors via applyServerErrors and returns 201 confirmation on valid submit.
T//02 Federation & adaptive-program intake renders all 5 briefing fields, escalation policy card, and briefing action.
EN/RU/TT parity, /health returns 200, zero pill-shaped UI elements (rounded-full banned on buttons/badges), and zero-orphan typography.
